import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
import warnings
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["PYTHONWARNINGS"] = "ignore"

# 1. Load Data
input_path = "./input"
submission_path = "./submission"

if not os.path.exists(submission_path):
    os.makedirs(submission_path)

train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_path, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_path, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_path, "sample_submission_null.csv"))

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")


# 2. Text Cleaning Function
def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        text = text.replace("\\n", "\n")
        text = text.strip('"')
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
        return text.lower()
    return str(text)


train_df["Comment_Clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment_Clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# 3. Split Train Data for Validation
train_part, val_part = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["Insult"]
)

print(f"Train part size: {len(train_part)}")
print(f"Val part size: {len(val_part)}")

# 4. Feature Extraction (Word + Character n-grams)
vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), strip_accents="unicode"
)

vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, ngram_range=(3, 3), analyzer="char_wb", strip_accents="unicode"
)

X_train_word = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(train_part["Comment_Clean"])
X_train_char = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(train_part["Comment_Clean"])

X_val_word = vectorizer_word.transform(val_part["Comment_Clean"])
X_val_char = vectorizer_char.transform(val_part["Comment_Clean"])

X_test_word = vectorizer_word.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_test_char = vectorizer_char.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"])

X_train = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

y_train = train_part["Insult"].values
y_val = val_part["Insult"].values

# 5. Train XGBoost Model
model_xgb = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    objective="binary:logistic",
    random_state=42,
    use_label_encoder=False,
    verbose=False,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

# 6. Train Logistic Regression Model (Replacing Random Forest)
model_lr = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="sag", n_jobs=-1, random_state=42)

# 7. Train XGBoost on Validation Split
model_xgb.fit(X_train, y_train)
# 8. Train Logistic Regression on Validation Split
model_lr.fit(X_train, y_train)

# 9. Predict on Validation Set
y_pred_xgb = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
y_pred_lr = model_lr.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
y_pred_val = (y_pred_xgb + y_pred_lr) / 2

val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_pred_val)

print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score (Ensemble): {val_auc:.4f}")

# 10. Train Final Models on Full Training Data
X_full_word = vectorizer_word.transform(train_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_full_char = vectorizer_char.transform(train_df["Comment_Clean"])
X_full = hstack([X_full_word, X_full_char])
y_full = train_df["Insult"].values

model_xgb_final = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    objective="binary:logistic",
    random_state=42,
    use_label_encoder=False,
    verbose=False,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
model_xgb_final.fit(X_full, y_full)

model_lr_final = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, solver="sag", n_jobs=-1, random_state=42
)
model_lr_final.fit(X_full, y_full)

# 11. Predict on Test Set
y_pred_test_xgb = model_xgb_final.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
y_pred_test_lr = model_lr_final.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
y_pred_test = (y_pred_test_xgb + y_pred_test_lr) / 2

# 12. Create Submission File (Insult in first column as per benchmark instructions)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Insult": y_pred_test})
submission_df.insert(1, "Comment", test_df["Comment"])
submission_df.insert(2, "Date", test_df["Date"])

os.makedirs(submission_path, exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(submission_path, "submission.csv"), index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to {os.path.join(submission_path, 'submission.csv')}")
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(y_pred_test)}")
plan: I will replace the Random Forest classifier in the ensemble with a Logistic Regression model to increase model diversity. This introduces a linear decision boundary alongside the tree-based XGBoost model, potentially capturing different patterns in the text features. I will maintain the same TF-IDF feature extraction, validation hold-out protocol, and simple averaging strategy to ensure the change is isolated and comparable to the baseline. This modification is distinct from the Stacking approach and the Date-based feature engineering attempts in previous runs.
